{{Top|ca|leg}}
A '''system economist''' was a type of<ref name="GG62">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref> [[Economist/Legends|economist]]<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|business/13314_1.html|Currency Upheavals Deliver Profits to IBC}}</ref> who practiced the [[system economics]] discipline.<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011206a_oblivion&c=swlfc|text=Cularin's Lady Senator, Lavina Wren}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], shifting priorities caused the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to end contracts with the outdated, polluting military industry of [[Shesharile 5]] and [[Shesharile 6]], [[Moon/Legends|moons]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]<ref name="GG62" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Shesharile">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Shesharile system/Legends|Shesharile system]]</ref> As a result, the [[Twin Planets|pair]] of moons experienced a rapid economic collapse that was exacerbated by the discovery and introduction by the [[drug dealer]] [[Shlith-dan]] of an uncommon [[Unidentified fungus|fungus]] that had addiction-causing effects in the population of Shesharile 5 and Shesharile 6. System economists subsequently expressed concerns that the economic depression of the [[Shesharile system/Legends|Shesharile system]] moons could expand to other worlds. However, that was unlikely due to the economies of the natural satellites having been relatively specialized.<ref name="GG62" />

==Behind the scenes==
The occupation of system economist was introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]'', a [[1990]] sourcebook authored by [[Mark Rein-Hagen]] and [[Stewart Wieck]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG1">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
